Create group comparison table

create_group_comparison_table.Rd

Creates table comparing coefficients weights with both groups using the Wald test. Saves the table as data/tables/table_group_comparison.html.

Usage

create_group_comparison_table()

Value

gt table

Examples

create_group_comparison_table()
